Guided Hikes
Did you know the Natural Lands Program manages over 6,600 acres of preserved land? Let our
knowledgeable guides walk you through some of Seminole County’s most beautiful wilderness
areas. Hikes fill up quickly, so sign up today by visiting: recreation.seminolecountyfl.gov
All hikes are $5 per guest. Children must be 7 years or older (unless otherwise noted) and
accompanied by an adult to attend. Call 407.665.2216 for more information.

Wilderness Areas and Preserves
Did you know that the Natural Lands Program
manages 9 public wild lands for you to explore? No
matter where you live in the county, there is likely a
wilderness area close by.
Trails are open from sun rise to sunset every day of
the year (unless otherwise noted). Parking and entry
are always free!
Enjoy recreational activities like hiking, birding, biking,
photography, horseback riding, fishing and more!
Each location has a unique combination of plant
communities, animals and ecosystems. We can’t wait
to see you out there.
Happy Adventuring!
